about: I'm a Computer Science student at the University of Waterloo who likes building things…

awards.title: President's Scholarship of Distinction
awards.description: Received the President's Scholarship of Distinction for an admission average of over 95%.

awards.title: Specialist High Skills Major
awards.description: Completed the Health and Wellness Specialist High Skills Major (SHSM) program in grades 11 and 12.

awards.title: Highest Score in Euclid Mathematics Competition
awards.description: Received the highest score (school-wide) for the 2025 Euclid mathematics competition.

awards.title: University of Toronto National Book Award
awards.description: Received a nomination for the University of Toronto National Book Award. The National Scholarship program awards students with creativity, originality, and dedication to a variety of interests.

awards.title: Honour Roll
awards.description: I received an average mark of above 80% in grades 9, 10, 11, and 12.

awards.title: Canadian Senior Mathematics Contest
awards.description: Received a Certificate of Distinction for placing top 25% in the 2023 Canadian Senior Mathematics Contest (CSMC).

awards.title: Student Achievement Awards Art Contest
awards.description: Placed second in my category for a digital artwork created for the “Our Moment in Time” Ontario Secondary School Teachers' Federation (OSSTF) Student Achievement Awards art contest.

volunteering.title: Elementary School Teacher's Assistant
volunteering.description: Assisted an elementary school teacher with setting up the classroom for the new school year. I organized classroom materials, created posters to promote learning, decorated bulletin boards, and arranged worksheets into duotangs.

volunteering.title: Peer Tutor
volunteering.description: At the start of each semester, I was paired with a younger student to help them with a course I had already completed. Some ways I assisted them was explaining new concepts, walking them through questions, correcting their homework solutions, and answering their questions.

li_projects.title: SnuffleStudy
li_projects.description: Privacy-first Chrome extension with real-time study rooms (LiveKit video/audio) and recorded nudges for peer accountability. Delivered friend notifications across 6 real-time event streams with zero background sync outside opted-in sessions. Secured a friend-approved restriction system with salted-hash, rate-limited passcodes, validated by 35/35 automated authorization tests, including a live bypa

li_projects.title: Design Portfolio
li_projects.description: chloechan.ca Hand-illustrated every asset in Procreate, built the design system in Figma, and converted it into a responsive live site showcasing all my projects.

li_projects.title: Reverielle
li_projects.description: Co-developed an AI mobile app whose agentic outfit planner uses live weather, calendar context, and wardrobe data via Claude tool use. Co-built a face-structure-aware makeup tutorial engine tested across 5+ face shapes, addressing underrepresented East Asian facial features in mainstream AI beauty apps.

name: Chloe Chan
